title: Staging local connector allowlist identifier replay contract

phases.objective: Make every direct local_connector_shell_allowlists writer provide its required allowlist_id so the ordered Staging schema replay is valid under MariaDB 11.4 strict mode, while adding a fail-closed builder guard against future omissions.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging schema bundle generator and disposable MariaDB 11.4
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact merged Staging checkout validates local connector allowlist writers and applies the complete baseline-plus-migration chain in disposable local MariaDB.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Migrations 032, 036, 156, and 159 satisfy the allowlist_id contract, the static builder guard passes, and the schema-only bundle route remains forbidden from Production, providers, credentials, and data export.
steps: Inventory the canonical baseline and numerically ordered migration chain in plan-only mode.
Validate every direct local_connector_shell_allowlists INSERT includes a non-null allowlist_id column and values where applicable.
Apply all migrations through migration 159 in disposable local MariaDB 11.4 and require the schema-only bundle contract.
Keep Production mutation, provider mutation, deployment, credential payload reads, and data export forbidden.
assertions: Historical local connector seed writers use deterministic allowlist identifiers rather than implicit missing defaults.
Migration 156 inserts the diff_name_status allowlist row with an explicit identifier.
Migration 159 remains idempotent through its config-and-alias duplicate key while carrying explicit identifiers.
The builder fails closed when a future direct local_connector_shell_allowlists INSERT omits allowlist_id.
The local replay uses only disposable MariaDB 11.4 and preserves schema_only=true with Production/provider/data/secrets safety flags false.
